findings.body: The log is written to a newly allocated, discarded TestLogger, so the supplied fake still reports zero calls and tests cannot observe the emitted message or attributes.
findings.failure_mode: Logs emitted through a context-derived fake logger are silently detached from the object inspected by the test.
findings.impact: The log is written to a newly allocated, discarded TestLogger, so the supplied fake still reports zero calls and tests cannot observe the emitted message or attributes.
findings.root_cause: The fake implements FromContext by allocating an independent recorder rather than preserving the original recorder's state.
findings.suggested_fix: Return the receiver, or return a contextual child that shares the receiver's log-recording state.
findings.title: FromContext discards the TestLogger's recording state
findings.trigger: A test enables LoggerMiddleware and supplies NewTestLogger; LoggerMiddleware invokes FromContext(ctx) before writing the completion log.
findings.verifier_reason: Line 47 verbatim shows `return NewTestLogger()` in FromContext. This allocates a fresh TestLogger disconnected from the receiver, so logs written via FromContext are not recorded on the original TestLogger. The trigger (LoggerMiddleware calling FromContext) and impact (test assertions fail) are realistic.

findings.body: The downstream type no longer implements Logger, causing compile-time failures at assignments and calls accepting the interface.
findings.failure_mode: Previously valid Logger implementations fail interface satisfaction during compilation.
findings.impact: The downstream type no longer implements Logger, causing compile-time failures at assignments and calls accepting the interface.
findings.root_cause: A new required method was added directly to an exported interface without a compatibility path for existing implementations.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep Logger source-compatible by introducing a separate optional contextual-logger interface and type-asserting it in LoggerMiddleware, with a fallback to the original logger.
findings.title: Adding FromContext to Logger breaks existing implementations
findings.trigger: Any downstream package upgrades Grafana while providing its own type that previously satisfied plugins/log.Logger.
findings.verifier_reason: Line 23 adds `FromContext(ctx context.Context) Logger` to the exported Logger interface. Any external type previously satisfying Logger now fails compilation. This is a breaking API change introduced by the patch.

<!--

Thank you for sending a pull request! Here are some tips:

1. If this is your first time, please read our contribution guide at https://github.com/grafana/grafana/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

2. Ensure you include and run the appropriate tests as part of your Pull Request.

3. In a new feature or configuration option, an update to the documentation is necessary. Everything related to the documentation is under the docs folder in the root of the repository.

4. If the Pull Request is a work in progress, make use of GitHub's "Draft PR" feature and mark it as such.

5. If you can not merge your Pull Request due to a merge conflict, Rebase it. This gets it in sync with the main branch.

6. Name your PR as "<FeatureArea>: Describe your change", e.g. Alerting: Prevent race condition. If it's a fix or feature relevant for the changelog describe the user impact in the title. The PR title is used to auto-generate the changelog for issues marked with the "add to changelog" label.

7. If your PR content should be added to the What's New document for the next major or minor release, add the **add to what's new** label to your PR. Note that you should add this label to the main PR that introduces the feature; do not add this label to smaller PRs for the feature.

-->

**What is this feature?**

- Renames the `InstrumentationMiddleware` to `MetricsMiddleware`
- Moves the contextual logger from the `Instrumentation/Metrics middleware` to the `LoggerMiddleware`

**Why do we need this feature?**

Better naming and consistency.

**Who is this feature for?**

Plugins platform.

**Which issue(s) does this PR fix?**:

<!--

- Automatically closes linked issue when the Pull Request is merged.

Usage: "Fixes #<issue number>", or "Fixes (paste link of issue)"

-->

Fixes #

**Special notes for your reviewer:**

Please check that:
- [x] It works as expected from a user's perspective.
- [x] If this is a pre-GA feature, it is behind a feature toggle.
- [x] The docs are updated, and if this is a [notable improvement](https://grafana.com/docs/writers-toolkit/writing-guide/contribute-release-notes/#how-to-determine-if-content-belongs-in-a-whats-new-document), it's added to our [What's New](https://grafana.com/docs/writers-toolkit/writing-guide/contribute-release-notes/) doc.

raw_findings.body: The caller fails to compile because the exported constructor no longer exists.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Existing consumers encounter an undefined-symbol compile error after upgrading.
raw_findings.impact: The caller fails to compile because the exported constructor no longer exists.
raw_findings.root_cause: The exported constructor was hard-renamed without preserving an alias or forwarding compatibility shim.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Retain NewInstrumentationMiddleware as a deprecated forwarding wrapper around NewMetricsMiddleware.
raw_findings.title: The constructor rename removes source compatibility
raw_findings.trigger: A downstream caller updates to this revision while still invoking the exported NewInstrumentationMiddleware constructor.

raw_findings.body: The package fails to compile because the previously exported type has been removed.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Existing source references resolve to no declared type.
raw_findings.impact: The package fails to compile because the previously exported type has been removed.
raw_findings.root_cause: The exported concrete type was renamed without retaining a compatibility alias.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Add a deprecated type alias, `type InstrumentationMiddleware = MetricsMiddleware`.
raw_findings.title: The exported middleware type rename removes source compatibility
raw_findings.trigger: A downstream package refers to InstrumentationMiddleware in a declaration, embedding, type assertion, or function signature after upgrading.

raw_findings.body: Completion logs no longer contain pluginId, endpoint, uname, dsName, or dsUID, even though LoggerMiddleware previously emitted those fields itself.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Valid standalone or differently ordered middleware compositions emit incomplete request logs.
raw_findings.impact: Completion logs no longer contain pluginId, endpoint, uname, dsName, or dsUID, even though LoggerMiddleware previously emitted those fields itself.
raw_findings.root_cause: Request metadata was removed from LoggerMiddleware and replaced with an implicit ordering dependency on a separately exported middleware.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Make LoggerMiddleware enrich the context from each request before logging, or have NewLoggerMiddleware compose the contextual middleware internally so its behavior does not depend on undocumented external ordering.
raw_findings.title: LoggerMiddleware now silently depends on a separate middleware for request labels
raw_findings.trigger: A caller uses the exported NewLoggerMiddleware independently, or composes it outside NewContextualLoggerMiddleware or in the opposite order.

raw_findings.body: A regression in context propagation, middleware ordering, or FromContext handling can drop completion-log attributes while the existing metrics-only tests continue to pass.
raw_findings.failure_mode: CI validates metric emission but does not detect broken contextual request logging.
raw_findings.impact: A regression in context propagation, middleware ordering, or FromContext handling can drop completion-log attributes while the existing metrics-only tests continue to pass.
raw_findings.root_cause: The patch moved log enrichment into a new middleware and changed the logging call path without adding assertions for the resulting log attributes.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Add middleware tests that execute the standard chain with a context-aware capturing logger and assert pluginId, endpoint, dsName, dsUID, uname, and traceID on the completion log.
raw_findings.title: The moved contextual logging behavior lacks regression coverage
raw_findings.trigger: QueryData runs through the new ContextualLoggerMiddleware and LoggerMiddleware chain with plugin, datasource, user, and tracing metadata.
